author: Artamiel_
body: Hello, my username is jvlex2399. But you can just call me Ethan if you would like. I was banned a very long time ago, because I was young and dumb and thought anyone that could kill me was hacking. I thought I was the shit and started cussing at people left and right. And I acknowledge the fact that I deserved the ban for all the things I said. But now, I really have matured and would love to be a part of this community. Maybe even an admin myself. Thanks for taking the time to read this.

replies.body:
Hey Jvlex,
